WITH base AS (
 SELECT f.*, cp.subcategory AS cur_sub, p.subcategory AS asw_sub, p.category pcat
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
 WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
)
SELECT cur_sub, asw_sub, pcat, count(*) n, count(distinct (receipt_id, line_no)) dist_lines, count(distinct sales_line_id) dist_ids, sum(quantity) qty, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) staff_qty, min(quantity) minq, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), count(distinct etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM base GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH f AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, f.quantity, f.net_amount, p.category
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE s.store_id=108 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=3 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')
SELECT (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM f) AS fact_units, (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM f) AS fact_net,
 (SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE r.store_id=108 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=3) AS rpt_units,
 (SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE r.store_id=108 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=3) AS rpt_net,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=3) AS n_days,
 (SELECT min(calendar_date)||' '||max(calendar_date) FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=3) AS rng

SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, 'Interior Paint' AS subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold, count(*) AS n_lines, max(f.quantity) AS max_qty,
 (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_returned),0) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f2 ON f2.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key=f2.store_key JOIN dim_product p2 ON p2.product_key=f2.product_key JOIN dim_product cp2 ON cp2.sku=p2.sku AND cp2.is_current JOIN dim_date d2 ON d2.calendar_date=f2.sale_date WHERE s2.store_id=108 AND cp2.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND d2.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d2.fiscal_period=3) AS returned_units_memo
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=3
GROUP BY 1,2
